events.title: Backdraft Demo Version 0.6 - Controller Support & Balance
events.summary: Controller Support - Added controller support across menus, hero selection, encounters, and combat. - Navigate your hand and choose targets with left/right. Press A to select a card, then again to play it. Press B to cancel. - In Adventure setup, use LB/RB to change secondary elements and LT/RT to adjust Heat. - Press View to open your card piles, LB/RB to switch between Draw and Discard, and B to close. - Keyboard navigation is now available throughout menus and combat too. Spell Upgrades - Pas

events.title: Backdraft Demo Version 0.5 - A New Adventure
events.summary: Adventure Mode - Each Adventure run is now a trip across a longer map route that ends at a treasure chest. - It opens on a new portal screen with elemental portals, crack effects, and opponent previews. - Your Adventure wins now appear as gems placed across the world in order, replacing the win counter. Heat Levels - Heat Levels are now playable for both Tara and Elric in the Demo. - Each hero remembers the Heat Level you last picked. - We're looking for feedback on these, so please let us know

events.title: Backdraft Demo Version 0.4 - Heat Level Challenges
events.summary: New Heat Level System - Run difficulty modifiers that unlock and stack as you complete them - 1: Opponents are harder - 2: Opponents have better decks - 3: Opponents carry an extra artifact - 4: Player starts with fewer lives - 5: Final opponent has an extra life Combat Upgrades - Upgrade now levels up a card for the duration of the current combat - Once a card is max level, it continues to gain +1 like Sharpen/Strengthen - Rivet: Rally changed from Sharpen to Upgrade - Elric: Hero power changed
